title: Where the hell do people get the courage to share their thoughts online?
description: I put in quite an effort to make my own blog engine, just to end up being afraid to post anything. I was even thinking I will share links of these posts to direct attention to my little corner of the internet! Now I am realizing this is the scariest thing ever.

title: How the hell do people have the courage to just post on the internet?
description: Even tho I put in quite an effort to create this custom blog-engine, I am really scared to use it. And now here I am writing my first post about cyber anxiety.
